# Redmond Dispatch

> The Redmond Dispatch is a free weekly email newsletter about Redmond, WA, sent Thursdays at 6 AM Pacific and published by Neighborhood Press LLC. It covers city council decisions, land-use and permit notices, road and transit changes, school district news, openings and closings, with one section per neighborhood. Every item links its public source. It is researched and written with AI tools, and an editor reads every issue before it goes out.

## Key pages
- [This week in Redmond](https://www.redmonddispatch.com/this-week/): the dated items for the current week, updated every Thursday
- [Redmond news](https://www.redmonddispatch.com/news/): every story, newest first
- [Reader asked](https://www.redmonddispatch.com/asked/): readers' questions answered from the public record
- [Standards](https://www.redmonddispatch.com/standards/): publisher, sources, sponsors, corrections
- [Subscribe](https://www.redmonddispatch.com/): free, one email a week

## Neighborhoods
- [Bear Creek](https://www.redmonddispatch.com/bear-creek/): Redmond's east side between the slopes of Education Hill and the city limit, where salmon-bearing Bear Creek and Evans Creek run past farmland and parks.
- [Downtown](https://www.redmonddispatch.com/downtown/): Redmond Town Center, Downtown Park, the Redmond Central Connector trail and the light rail station at the heart of the city.
- [Education Hill](https://www.redmonddispatch.com/education-hill/): The hill between the Sammamish Valley and the Bear Creek valley, with Hartman Park, Meadow Park and views of the Cascades.
- [Grass Lawn](https://www.redmonddispatch.com/grass-lawn/): Redmond's west-side hillside around Grass Lawn Park, looking over the Sammamish Valley toward the Cascades.
- [Idylwood](https://www.redmonddispatch.com/idylwood/): The slope above Lake Sammamish's north end, with Idylwood Beach Park's swimming beach and views across to Marymoor Park.
- [North Redmond](https://www.redmonddispatch.com/north-redmond/): The city's northeastern corner, with the Puget Power Trail, NE 116th Street and the old cow path that became NE 124th Street.
- [Overlake](https://www.redmonddispatch.com/overlake/): Redmond's second urban center: the Microsoft campus, Esterra Park, the 156th Avenue NE corridor and two light rail stations.
- [Sammamish Valley](https://www.redmonddispatch.com/sammamish-valley/): The river valley from downtown north to the city limit between Education Hill and Willows Road, from business parks to farm fields and the river trail.
- [Southeast Redmond](https://www.redmonddispatch.com/southeast-redmond/): East of Marymoor Park and the end of SR 520, from Marymoor Village south and east to the city limit.
- [Willows / Rose Hill](https://www.redmonddispatch.com/willows-rose-hill/): Northwest Redmond between Willows Road and 132nd Avenue NE, from Redmond Way and NE 85th Street up to NE 124th Street.
